verdicts.item: B1B-02 / B1D-02 first read / B1B-05 mid-run /result expecting 202 with PENDING pinned
verdicts.reason: openapi readGuidedResult: 202 = pending publication; the controller returns PENDING ? 202 : 200; the clause is a pre-publication projection
The read is unheld and races SOURCE_PLAN failure; status is bound to the body's publication.status and v3/result is validated; c5Capture is null under B1 cuts, so no sink is lost

verdicts.item: B2A-01 publish first, then the 200 recording and sinks
verdicts.reason: The read belongs to post-publication recording; matches every pre-existing assertGuidedLearnRunRecorded caller and the A28-5 OBS-007 sink set. Wording note: the sinks are the post-publication set, not a strict superset.

verdicts.rule: The expected status always equals the contract projection (PENDING -> 202, otherwise 200); a mid-run clause reads mid-run, and a post-publication clause publishes first
